shortDescription: Introduce Elegance and Style with the stunning Carly Irish Bedroom range. All designed and manufactured here in Ireland bringing you excellent quality and value for money. Both Bas
description:
Introduce Elegance and Style with the stunning Carly Irish Bedroom range. All designed and manufactured here in Ireland bringing you excellent quality and value for money. Both Base and Headboard have been Upholstered in chic Naples Beige Fabric with round castor feet which would complement any décor and enhance the overall look. 
The dramatic 27" high end headboard, which is removable, creates a striking focal point for your space and will create a luxurious feel to your bedroom. The beauty about the Carla Bedroom range is that the bottom of the bed is completely free and does not have any footboard, creating more space in your bedroom. The base provides a stable platform for your mattress and both Head Board and Base will certainly create a stylish and welcoming place where you will enjoy relaxing.
Sizes Available - 3Ft Single, 4Ft Small Double, 4Ft 6 Double, 5Ft King and 6Ft Super King

description:
This modern rug has it all, it is soft to the touch, cosy and is beautiful to look at. A clever blend of contemporary rich colours has been used against a cream background and placed there using abstract mixture of patterns.
This rug is designed to be a feature no matter where it is placed, alternatively it can also act as the perfect rug to hold a coffee table or centre piece in any room. Each end of the rug has been folded over rather than showing the usual border. The low shaggy pile allows this rug to have the benefits of a shaggy rug while also having a strong pattern of a modern rug. Designed to be practical, aesthetically pleasing as well as offering warmth and comfort in the home, this is the perfect contemporary rug.
